title: Release + retro + version bump
value: CHANGELOG/RELEASE_NOTES + retro + next-version storyboard delta
acceptance_criteria: AC1 CHANGELOG+RELEASE_NOTES (HITL commits); AC2 retro memory entry; AC3 storyboard delta; AC4 $VERSION re-run reproducible
why: Ungoverned releases drift
what_if_missing: No retro -> pipeline never improves

title: Principle-I governance gates BLOCK an agent mutation (live)
value: Watch ADLC Principle-I gates actually block an agent IaC/AWS/Stripe mutation in real time -> velocity WITH control
acceptance_criteria: AC1 Given plugin installed, when agent attempts IaC mutation, then block-terraform-apply.sh exits 2 with Principle-I message on screen (verify: hook stderr in recording + tmp/ evidence); AC2 Given READONLY AWS profile, when describe/list runs, then exit 0 with result rows (governance precise not blanket-deny); AC3 Given the block, then an evidence JSON in tmp/ shows what was attempted and why blocked (verify: test -s evidence file); AC4 >=3 distinct Principle-I hooks demonstrated IaC/aws-mutation/stripe-write-key (verify: grep -c hook names >=3)
why: CTOs fear autonomous agents shipping unreviewed infra/financial mutations; governance is the #1 adoption blocker for agentic SDLC
what_if_missing: Without a visible block, the framework looks like ungated autonomy -> instant disqualification in any regulated or enterprise eval
business_value: Converts 'AI will go rogue' objection into 'AI prepares, humans commit' proof -> unblocks enterprise pilot conversations
purpose: Prove governable autonomy: velocity with Principle-I control, not slideware claims
critical_thinking: Must show a REAL hook exit-2, not a narrated claim (anti NATO_VIOLATION/slideware); also show a READONLY command SUCCEEDING so governance reads as precise, not blanket lockdown

title: Fork the Commerce plugin into own repo with clean evidence trail
value: Fork the Commerce plugin into my own repo and run /commerce:* against my own client stack with a clean evidence trail -> deliver client B2B faster while keeping my own audit record
acceptance_criteria: AC1 Given a fresh clone, when SI runs documented fork/install, then /commerce:* discoverable (>=14 commands listed; verify: command count >=14); AC2 Given plugin installed, when SI runs /commerce:visual-verify or tf-plan, then evidence is written to tmp/ in the SI's OWN repo (portable, not hardcoded to OceanSoft paths; verify: test -s evidence in SI workspace); AC3 Given borrow-as-init-draft IP stance, then licensing/ownership is unambiguous (OceanSoft owns from v0.1.0; SI owns their fork; verify: doc reference present); AC4 fork->first /commerce success in <30min (verify: timing evidence)
why: SIs are a force-multiplier channel; they adopt only if the plugin is forkable and produces their own audit trail, not vendor-locked
what_if_missing: If commands are hardcoded to OceanSoft paths or undocumented, SIs cannot resell -> channel adoption = 0
business_value: Each SI becomes a distribution node; one plugin -> many client deployments. Multiplies reach without OceanSoft headcount
purpose: Prove the plugin is a reusable product surface, not a one-customer bespoke artifact
critical_thinking: Must verify path-portability (no /Volumes/Working hardcodes leaking into SI workspace); anti INVISIBLE_PRIMARY_USER makes the SI a named ICP

title: Follow one /commerce:* command end-to-end and see its PDCA evidence trail
value: Follow one /commerce:* command end-to-end and see its PDCA evidence trail (coordination log -> execution -> cross-validation JSON) -> verify the framework's claims are evidence-backed (no NATO) before adopting
acceptance_criteria: AC1 Given /commerce:tf-plan runs, when it completes, then coordination log + execution evidence + verify output exist in tmp/ (verify: 3 evidence files present); AC2 Given the evidence trail, then every business-value claim has an evidence path, no NATO (verify: claims->evidence mapping); AC3 Given the PDCA loop, then a >=99.5% cross-validation or 3-agent-PASS artifact is visible (verify: pdca-evidence JSON); AC4 100% of demonstrated claims have an evidence path (verify: claim/evidence ratio == 1.0)
why: Evaluators distrust unsubstantiated 'AI productivity' claims; evidence-trail IS the differentiator vs hype tools
what_if_missing: Without an auditable trail, adoption stalls at 'prove it' -> framework reads as marketing
business_value: Evidence-backed claims shorten enterprise eval cycles; 'no NATO' becomes a competitive moat
purpose: Demonstrate the framework's core discipline (evidence over talk) as a buyable property
critical_thinking: The demo of evidence must ITSELF be evidence-backed (meta-honesty); claiming PDCA without showing the JSON = the exact NATO_VIOLATION this story disproves

title: Narrated-demo-reel skill (assemble + voiceover-cue reel)

acceptance_criteria: AC1 skill present and discoverable; AC2 takes act GIFs + narration-timing-sheet as input; AC3 outputs stitched reel reference

what_if_missing: No reusable assembly step -> every release re-improvises the reel
business_value: Repeatable narrated reel production per release
purpose: Operationalize the assembly phase as a skill
critical_thinking: Skill is the operational owner of P5 assembly; reuse across releases
